findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_ai_tools, compare_free_tiers, check_free_tier_claim, get_category_playbook · Private data: build_free_workflow, check_api_quota_fit, get_category_playbook, watch_free_tier_changes · Public sink: check_api_quota_fit, get_china_ai_rules, check_commercial_use, watch_free_tier_changes · Destructive: watch_free_tier_changes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_ai_tools, compare_free_tiers, check_free_tier_claim, get_category_playbook · Private data: build_free_workflow, check_api_quota_fit, get_category_playbook, watch_free_tier_changes · Public sink: check_api_quota_fit, get_china_ai_rules, check_commercial_use, watch_free_tier_changes · Destructive: watch_free_tier_changes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
